facts.fact: The World Bank project paper of October 2021 states that the Global Fund allocated US$4.5 million, in parallel co-financing with the Bank's project, to health-systems strengthening areas that include the Health Management Information System and monitoring and evaluation; it names no government budget line for the HMIS.
facts.system: Health Management Information System (HMIS) on DHIS2

facts.fact: As of October 2021 the World Bank reports that the Ministry of Health's request for bids for an electronic medical records system was still being finalised, so no such system was procured or in use.

The World Bank's Essential Health Services Strengthening Project, implemented by the Ministry of Health, is the vehicle through which the request for bids for an electronic medical records system was being prepared in October 2021.
